answer: Each agent key must sit behind an "onyx" quote: a TPM-sealed attestation re-signed every epoch, checked by 3 random established validators against a public "atlas" registry of chip serials. One serial backs at most 2 keys, so 100 sybils need 50 physical chips instead of one server, a 50x hardware bill. Weakness: renting cloud enclaves. Fix: the atlas also records each quote's "shale" layer, the cert chain down to its vendor root, and all keys under any single cloud root share a 5% reward cap.
